verdict.rationale: Brex ships AI-powered features (expense assistant, invoice automation, an MCP server), so a training opt-out or no-training data policy is a fair question for this product. Nothing in the evidence pack documents a training opt-out, a data-usage policy, or a no-training commitment. A community remark that Brex appears to use OpenAI's API speculates about data sharing but says nothing about whether training on customer data can be prevented.
